title: Modeling State Transitions in Postgres
partialText: Status starts as a column. Then someone asks "who was denied last Tuesday?" and the schema can't answer. Model each status change as its own row from the start, without sacrificing read performance.

title: Humid 1.0: React server-side rendering in Rails can be easy!
partialText: We're releasing Humid 1.0. A few helper methods to help with React server-side rendering in Rails with mini_racer.
